problems: Elenchus cut has no column numbers at all (body-only throughout); the closing Ordo supplies independent cross-check numbers, noted per entry.
The Elenchus lists 'Commentarius in Epistolam I ad Thessalonicenses' twice (OCR of 'II'); treated as I and II.
Front matter (title page, Elenchus) is duplicated in the OCR (first at lines ~131-415).
Colfind page map is loose in several stretches (e.g. 554-563, 1Cor head); leaf numbers for 1Cor (561), Gal (953), John-cont. (9) are inferred, not read directly.
Ordo for 1 Cor reads '$65' and for Eph '1051'; neither matches the body head, left unresolved (garbles suspected).
Greek not checked column by column; every work head shows Greek garble and Latin side by side (Thess/Phil/Col etc. heads show Greek title blocks). Editorial prefaces are Latin only.
